exercises.title: Types of homes (Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Find these in the pictures A–D: igloo, treehouse, houseboat, shipping container homes.

items.explanation: treehouse — nhà trên cây.
shipping container homes — nhà làm từ container chở hàng.
igloo — nhà tuyết hình vòm của người Inuit.
houseboat — nhà thuyền, sống trên mặt nước.

exercises.title: What is the passage about? (Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Read "Amazing homes" in ONE minute and choose one of the options.

stimulus.text:
Amazing homes

Most people live in a house or a flat. When they go on holiday they stay in a hotel or a guest house. But some places where you can live or stay are a bit different.

**1** One unusual place to live is a houseboat. Amsterdam in Holland is famous for its houseboats – there are about 2,500 of them. They have everything that a normal house has: a living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and even sometimes a terrace on the roof. They are cheaper than houses and people who live on houseboats enjoy being close to nature. Some houseboats can be moved to other parts of the river, while others are permanently in one place.

**2** In Tokyo, Japan, there is a see-through house. It is like a normal Japanese house but all the walls are made of glass. There is plenty of daylight but no privacy. Architect Sou Fujimoto designed it for a couple to make their home. He based his ideas on early man living in trees. It wouldn't suit everyone but the couple who live there love the feeling of being surrounded by the natural world.

**3** All around the world, people live in homes made from shipping containers. Some use only one container, while others are made from several containers joined together. One house in Chile was built from 12 containers. They are cheap to buy and eco-friendly. They can also be placed in the garden or drive as guest rooms, studies or utility rooms.

**4** In Germany, you can stay in a one-metre-square house, the smallest house in the world, called the House NA. Van Bo Le-Mentzel, a refugee from Laos, built it to draw attention to the world housing shortage. It is a wooden structure on wheels and weighs 40 kg. It has a locking door and a window. You can turn it onto its side when you want to lie down. Franz from Munich spent the night in one recently 'just to see what it was like'. He found it a bit uncomfortable!

**5** For an unusual holiday you can stay in an igloo, a house made of ice. These can be found in several countries including Sweden, Norway and Finland. They are built new every winter. Jenny and Callum, visitors from Australia, told us, 'We slept in an igloo last night. It's so cold here – minus 5 degrees centigrade. We used reindeer skins to keep warm!'

**6** Another couple, Shaun and Rachel from Manchester, enjoyed a recent holiday in a treehouse in Sussex, England. They said, 'It was right up in the trees and had everything we needed, even wifi! It had a small kitchen and we did our own cooking. It was the perfect place to get away from our busy lives.'
stimulus.caption: Amazing homes (p. 26)

items.prompt: What is the passage about?

options.text: Life in different cities around the world
Unusual places to live or stay around the world
The type of houses and flats most people live in

items.prompt: In which paragraph is "igloo"?
items.explanation: Đoạn 5: "you can stay in an igloo, a house made of ice".

items.prompt: Which activity practised SCANNING?
items.explanation: Tìm một từ/thông tin cụ thể = scanning.

exercises.title: Paraphrases (Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Match these words and phrases from the text (1–6) with their paraphrases (a–f).

items.explanation: houseboats = nhà thuyền → homes on the water.
permanently = vĩnh viễn, lâu dài → forever, always.
privacy = sự riêng tư → không bị người khác nhìn thấy.
surrounded by the natural world = được thiên nhiên bao quanh.
uncomfortable = không thoải mái → not feeling pleasant.
Thuỵ Điển, Na Uy, Phần Lan = các nước Bắc Âu (Nordic countries).

exercises.title: Choose the best paraphrase (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Choose the best paraphrase for these sentences from the text.

items.prompt: The treehouse had everything we needed.

options.text: We needed some more things for our stay in the treehouse.
The treehouse was very well equipped.
We need everything for the treehouse.

items.explanation: had everything we needed = được trang bị đầy đủ (well equipped).

items.prompt: Some houseboats can be moved to other parts of the river.

options.text: Not all houseboats are permanently fixed in one place.
Only some parts of the river have houseboats.
You can move to a houseboat in another part of the river.

items.explanation: Một số nhà thuyền di chuyển được → không phải tất cả đều cố định.

items.prompt: One house in Chile was built from 12 containers.

options.text: There are 12 houses in Chile made from containers.
12 containers were used to make one house.
You need 12 containers to make a house in Chile.

items.explanation: MỘT ngôi nhà, dùng 12 container. C sai vì nói như quy định chung.

exercises.title: Tenses in "Amazing homes" (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Answer these questions about the Amazing homes passage.

items.prompt: Which tenses does the passage use?
items.explanation: Bài mô tả nhà ở hiện tại (present) và kể trải nghiệm, việc xây nhà trong quá khứ (past) → cả hai.

items.prompt: Which tense is used to describe the houses?
items.explanation: They have everything that a normal house has…

items.prompt: Which tense is used to describe habit or things that are always true?
items.explanation: Most people live in a house or a flat.

items.prompt: Which tense is used to describe people's experiences on holidays?
items.explanation: We slept in an igloo last night… We used reindeer skins…

items.prompt: Which tense is used to talk about designing or building the house?
items.explanation: Sou Fujimoto designed it… One house in Chile was built from 12 containers.

exercises.title: Present simple or past simple? (Ex. 11)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct verb, present simple or past simple.

items.prompt: Most people in China ____ in flats.
items.explanation: Sự thật hiện tại.

items.prompt: In the UK most houses ____ gardens.
items.explanation: Sự thật chung ở Anh hiện nay → hiện tại đơn: have.

items.prompt: In 2010, my parents ____ to Australia.
items.explanation: In 2010 → quá khứ.

items.prompt: Nowadays Sarah usually ____ her holidays in cities.
items.explanation: Nowadays, usually → hiện tại đơn.

items.prompt: In the past she ____ beach holidays.
items.explanation: In the past → quá khứ.

exercises.title: Correct form of the verb (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verb in brackets.

items.prompt: Farid now ____ (share) a flat with some other students.
items.explanation: now + chủ ngữ số ít → shares.

items.prompt: Last year he ____ (live) at home with his parents.
items.explanation: Last year → quá khứ đơn: lived.

items.prompt: Once I ____ (stay) on a campsite next to a lake in Italy.
items.explanation: Once (đã từng một lần) → quá khứ.

items.prompt: My flat ____ (have) two balconies.
items.explanation: Mô tả căn hộ hiện tại, ngôi 3 số ít → has.

items.prompt: In 2014 we ____ (move) into our new house.
items.explanation: In 2014 → quá khứ đơn: moved.

exercises.instruction: Here are some pictures of places in a town. Match pictures A–G with the words in the box: railway station, museum, bank, harbour, sports centre, restaurant, bus stop.

items.explanation: sports centre — trung tâm thể thao.
museum — bảo tàng.
bank — ngân hàng.
railway station — ga tàu hoả.
bus stop — trạm xe buýt.
restaurant — nhà hàng.
harbour — bến cảng (nơi tàu thuyền neo đậu).

exercises.title: Groups of places (Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Put the words in exercise 1 into the correct group.

items.explanation: harbour — bến cảng, nơi tàu thuyền ra vào → giao thông.
bus stop — trạm xe buýt → giao thông.
railway station — ga tàu → giao thông.
sports centre — chơi thể thao → thể thao & giải trí.
restaurant — ăn uống, giải trí → leisure.
museum — bảo tàng → nghệ thuật & văn hoá.
bank — ngân hàng → tiền.

exercises.title: Which kind of answer? (Ex. 6–7)
exercises.instruction: Read the questions. Underline the key words. Which kind of information does each question need?

items.left: 1 What did the speakers order in the restaurant?
items.right: a meal or a kind of food
items.explanation: order in the restaurant → đáp án là món ăn.

items.left: 2 How much did each person pay for their meal?
items.explanation: How much… pay → giá tiền.

items.left: 3 What time is the bus due?
items.explanation: What time → giờ.
Where → địa điểm.

items.left: 5 How long did the course last?
items.explanation: How long → khoảng thời gian.

items.left: 6 Which TWO things did the speaker do on the course?
items.right: the names of activities or skills
items.explanation: Which TWO things did the speaker do → tên hoạt động/kỹ năng.

items.left: 7 What is the date of the next course?
items.explanation: What is the date → ngày tháng.
Who → tên người.

exercises.title: Do you need a number? (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Look at the questions in exercise 7. For which questions do you need to write a number?

items.text: 1 What did the speakers order in the restaurant?
items.explanation: Hỏi món ăn → viết chữ, không cần số.

items.text: 2 How much did each person pay for their meal?
items.explanation: Giá tiền.

items.text: 3 What time is the bus due?

items.explanation: Hỏi địa điểm → tên đường/nơi chốn, không phải số.

items.text: 5 How long did the course last?
items.explanation: Khoảng thời gian (2 days).

items.text: 6 Which TWO things did the speaker do on the course?
items.explanation: Hỏi hoạt động → chữ.

items.text: 7 What is the date of the next course?
items.explanation: Ngày tháng (1st September).
Hỏi tên người → chữ.

exercises.title: Word limits (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Answer the question. Write NO MORE THAN ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer. "What did the boy buy in the shopping mall?"

items.prompt: Which answer is correct?
items.explanation: "he bought shoes" = 3 từ, đề chỉ cho phép ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER → sai.

exercises.title: Check your answers (Ex. 11, 13)
exercises.instruction: Answer the questions about the exam rules.

items.prompt: "What time is the bus due?" The speaker says "7.50 pm to be exact". Which answer is correct?
items.explanation: 7.50 đúng; "seven fiftty" sai chính tả; 7.15 / seven fifteen là sai giờ.

items.prompt: "Where is the bus stop?" The speaker says "There's an e at the end of Blythe." Which answer is correct?
items.explanation: Người nói đánh vần có chữ e ở cuối Blythe → Blythe Road (chính tả phải đúng tuyệt đối).

items.prompt: In the Exam skills task, which questions need a number ONLY?
items.explanation: Q3 How many people (8), Q5 How much ($15). Q4 là địa chỉ — có số NHƯNG có cả tên đường.
